preconditions.description: The number of operations n is a positive integer within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i for i, p in enumerate(pis, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each parent vertex index pi is within the valid range for its operation step i.
The input list pis contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each operation.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 1 for cost in output)
postconditions.description: Each output cost is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= i + 1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The cost for the i-th operation (1-based) is at least 1 and at most the number of vertices after the operation (i+1).
Each output[i] is the minimum possible cost of coloring the tree after the i-th operation, where tree_after_i_operations is the tree constructed after i additions.
